answer: Pay agents on a convex curve: an identity's epoch reward grows with the square of its own accumulated graded score. Splitting one operator's effort across ten clones then yields roughly a tenth of the payout, so a sybil reef of shallow accounts earns less than one deep, basalt-solid identity. Scores never transfer between keys, and a sudden plume of fresh registrations starts near zero, so farming identities is simply a losing trade.
